name: Thread bumping
summary: A new reply moves its thread to the top of the board; a thread with no new replies falls down and, on an imageboard, is deleted.
how: Sort the threads by the time of the last reply.
Let a poster reply without a bump (sage on Japanese boards).
Delete the last thread when a new thread starts on a full board.

origin.note: On 2channel a reply bumps its thread up; a poster can choose sage to reply with no bump.

adoptions.via: 4chan bumps a thread on each reply and deletes the old threads at the bottom of the board.
